liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Blow Away** (2 reviews): Very high energy, with Brent going wild during the fist-in-the-air section; Reviewer's favorite Blow Away, along with a version from Meca, with Brent excellent [19][29]
- **The Wheel** (1 review, 1 other source): A big spinning light shone in front of Bob during the last chorus, after the 'bound to cover' line; The Wheel track includes the space segment [1][24]
- **Box Of Rain** (1 review): The Box Of Rain encore was played flawlessly, according to the reviewer [19]
- **Dear Mr. Fantasy** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Dear Mr. Fantasy as especially good [24]
- Reviewer singles out Wang Dang Doodle as especially good [24]
- The band was cooking early on in China Cat but lost some steam [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-04-08.141804.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 149 min [1]
- **gd1989-04-08.mtx.seamons.94166.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 143 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd89-04-08.sbd.26348.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 142 min; rated 3.89/5 by 28 [4]. Said about its sound: The soundboard is crisp, and the tight playing comes through well; Reviewer finds the sound quality good overall [22][27]
- **gd1989-04-08.147895.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 143 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1989-04-08.147838.sbd.ultramatrix.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 21 songs; 143 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood in the fourth row for this show [19]
- A man got onstage during West LA and crouched near Jerry, who kept playing until security removed him [20]
- Reviewer's last show of the tour, after Atlanta, Greensboro, Pittsburgh and Ann Arbor, plus an R.E.M. show in Atlanta [21]
- A Cincinnati Reds game next door that day meant parents with kids walked through the Shakedown lot to reach the ballpark [23]
- Inside, the yellow-jacketed staff were elderly, so people could roam freely [23]
- Baseball game traffic caused a big parking problem; many fans parked at Union Terminal and were bussed in [26]
- Reviewer ranks this Blow Away among the best versions they have heard, with Brent playing hard [18]
- Reviewer says Brent shone on this tour more than at other points [21]
- Reviewer says this was the only Dead show at this venue and the band never returned to Riverbend in Cincinnati [26]
- Reviewer notes the band had played Riverfront Arena before, going back to 1976 [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-04-08.141804.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Ted Mattes' Master Audience PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100 deck, Sony ESX-HiFi/L750 tape); Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics, ortf (OTS) [1]
- **gd1989-04-08.mtx.seamons.94166.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: Audience source: front of board, 14th row, Beyer M88 mics into Sony TCD5M cassette recorder; Charlie Connor's cassette master; Charlie Miller handled the transfers and mastering; tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; a soundboard cassette master is also credited [3]
- **gd89-04-08.sbd.26348.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Cassette Master> Dat> CD> EAC> SHN [4]
- **gd1989-04-08.147895.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [5]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; Charlie Miller mastered it, using two sets of masters to complete the show [5]
- **gd1989-04-08.147838.sbd.ultramatrix.miller.flac24**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [6]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; Charlie Miller mastered it, combining two sets of masters to make the show complete [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Riverfront Arena - April 8, 1989](https://www.dead.net/show/april-8-1989) [31]
- Poster by Sora Devore: [Dumbek's Random Stuff](https://dumbek.blogspot.com/) [32]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-04-08 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-04-08-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [33]
